admission.directiveSpacing: one ASCII space between grammar tokens; metadata text may contain printable ASCII/TAB; no trailing directive whitespace
admission.metadataPosition: any header position after format and before end_header
admission.elements: one positive uint32 vertex, no other element
admission.propertyType: float, IEEE754 binary32 little-endian; no aliases/lists
admission.payloadLength: vertexCount * recordBytes, exact; overflow checked before allocation
admission.normals: finite ignored placeholders, never surface-normal evidence
admission.classification: any GS-specific opacity/scale_/rot_/f_dc_/f_rest_ signature with incomplete schema is unsupported; never ordinary-point fallback
admission.budget: caller maxFileBytes, maxItems, maxValues and operation work limits apply before allocation; not intrinsic large-file support

preservation.negativeZero: original bits retained; summary/derived values normalize to +0
preservation.physicalUnit: unknown; no automatic meter or axis/origin conversion
preservation.representationToAsset: fresh import uses identity; received explicit canonical Sim(3)/reflection is verified and applied without changing source bytes; numeric placement is not physical registration

activation.axisVariance: exp(2*s), not exp(s)^2; finite and strictly positive; 2*s is binary64 after exact f32 decode
activation.quaternion: wxyz; n=sqrt(((w*w+x*x)+y*y)+z*z); reject n==0; divide by n; canonical sign first nonzero w,x,y,z positive
activation.covariance: For i<=j, p[k]=(R[i,k]*axisVariance[k])*R[j,k] for k=0,1,2; Sigma[i,j]=(p[0]+p[1])+p[2]; copy Sigma[j,i]. Nonfinite rejected, valid zero offdiagonals allowed.

assetFrameContext.require: exact recorded canonical representationToAsset validated under specification01; source schema does not infer it
assetFrameContext.linear: L[i,k]=(uniformScale*Rplacement[i,k])*F[k,k]; F=diag(-1,1,1) for reflection x, identity otherwise
assetFrameContext.finite: require finite transformed mean/covariance and positive diagonals; offdiagonal zero allowed; bounds use meanAsset/covarianceAsset

sourceSupport.emptyRule: alpha < threshold; preserve row/count but omit from source bounds
sourceSupport.rawComponentRadius: 4*sqrt(covarianceAsset[i,i]); finite; every subsequent mean denotes meanAsset
sourceSupport.rawUnion: componentwise min(mean-radius), max(mean+radius) over every nonempty row, before padding
sourceSupport.scale: per axis max(1, max(abs(mean[i])), max(rawComponentRadius[i])) over all nonempty rows
sourceSupport.nextDownUp: adjacent IEEE754 binary64 toward -/+infinity; finite output required; no output negative zero
sourceSupport.union: pad the complete raw union once; all-empty input unsupported

retainedBoundsVerification.scale: the same all-nonempty-row per-axis scale used by writer
retainedBoundsVerification.require: Each stored min <= recomputed raw union min and each stored max >= recomputed raw union max; each stored component differs from the padded writer union component by no more than tolerance. No inward raw bound, widening on mismatch, or immutable record/digest rewrite.
retainedBoundsVerification.scope: only this new GS profile; existing profile exact comparisons unchanged

sourceSupport.verifiedFactsOutput: After complete original-byte/profile/context inspection and retainedBoundsVerification, return the exact verified retained logicalBoundsAsset as representation content bounds and GS source family envelope. Fresh creation uses the writer bounds. Never return a different recomputed padded union against an accepted retained record; do not relax generic facts containment.
sourceSupport.viewFilter: screen blur/AA/viewport caps are view-only and separately bounded for culling, never source bounds; packed/LOD library bbox is not source authority

sphericalHarmonics.coefficientOrder: DC RGB; remaining basis1..K-1 contiguous R, then G, then B
sphericalHarmonics.direction: normalize(inverse(full Representation-to-Project linear Sim(3)/reflection) * (meanProject-cameraProject)); never individual Gaussian q
sphericalHarmonics.coincidentCamera: no directional sample for that primitive (near-clipped); no whole-Asset unsupported
sphericalHarmonics.evaluation: per channel, ascending basis index, accumulate factor*polynomial*coefficient in binary64, then +0.5, then max(value,0); no upper clamp
sphericalHarmonics.presentation: renderer quantization/filtering are a separate qualified policy, never source facts

facts.family: one source GS family and one GS class; Proxy has no class
